Author: PayneZA
Name: My Mod Manager
Punchline: An animation mode for Penumbra: find, sort and play your animation mods.
Description: An animation mode for Penumbra: a library of your roleplay animation mods (and any other mods) with the exact emote and pose to use, one-click Play, file-based detection of emotes and poses, pack splitting, SFW/NSFW sorting and Safe view. Unofficial, made for the author and close friends; no official support.
